title: [3.0 beta3/4] QuickWizard editor end-time not displayed correctly
body:
On editing an existing QuickWizard setting, the Start time is displayed in both start and end time fields.
If end time is edited, the new value is displayed in the start time field.  However, if editor closed with OK, the correct start and end times are shown in the QuickWizard List.
